region_scene_page.compact: A raw 1960s singles road of local teen bands, fuzz riffs, cheap organs, shouted hooks, and proto-punk attitude.
region_scene_page.standard: After the British Invasion, countless local groups made fast, rough records for regional labels. The Kingsmen, The Sonics, The Seeds, Count Five, ? and the Mysterians, and The Standells show a world where crude energy often matters more than refinement. Nuggets later gave that world a durable map. The lane is song-first and texture-first: fuzz guitar, Farfisa organ, stomp rhythm, nasal vocals, and riffs simple enough to become slogans.
